title: Sales callers stuck on hold with no answer
story: Customers call the sales line and choose Sales in the IVR. They wait on hold for a long time with no agent answering.
Sales team members do not see incoming calls. Team leads watch wait times climb and see missed calls. Some customers hang up and do not get a callback or voicemail.
Sarah in the contact centre and Mark in ops both report the same issue. They ask you to check the environment and fix whatever is wrong.
